parts.text: North 18 km A D C B 10 km 21 km 12 km 150° North NOT TO SCALE The diagram shows four villages A , B , C and D and five straight roads connecting them. B is 10 km due east of A . C is 12 km from B on a bearing of 150°. D is 21 km from C and 18 km from A .

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Calculate the distance AC and show that your answer rounds to 19.08 km, correct to 2 decimal places. [4]

parts.label: b

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) A straight path, BP , connects B to the closest point, P , on AC . Calculate the length of this path. ............................................... km [2]
